scene.title: Balancing Methane Combustion
scene.summary: Step‑by‑step balancing of CH₄ + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O to CH₄ + 2 O₂ → CO₂ + 2 H₂O.

beats.title: Unbalanced equation
beats.narration: The combustion of methane starts as CH₄ + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O.

beats.title: Count atoms
beats.narration: Count atoms of each element on both sides of the equation.

beats.title: Add hydrogen coefficient
beats.narration: Hydrogen is balanced by placing a 2 in front of H₂O.

check.question: What coefficient should multiply O₂ to balance oxygen?
check.explain: Right side has 4 O atoms (2 from CO₂ + 2 from 2 H₂O), so 2 O₂ gives 4 O atoms.

beats.title: Final balanced equation
beats.narration: Insert the needed O₂ coefficient and the equation is balanced.

beats.title: Recap
beats.narration: Balanced combustion: one methane reacts with two oxygen molecules to produce carbon dioxide and water.
